name: Shoppable Image · Shop the Look
description: Campaign image with interactive product hotspots, Quick Add, free product selection, or Product Set validation.

attribute_definition_groups.name: Shoppable Image · Shop the Look
attribute_definition_groups.description: Campaign image with interactive product hotspots, Quick Add, free product selection, or Product Set validation.

attribute_definitions.name: Desktop image
attribute_definitions.description: Select or upload the primary campaign image. It is displayed without automatic cropping.

attribute_definitions.name: Mobile image (optional)
attribute_definitions.description: Optional mobile crop. When supplied, configure the mobile position of each hotspot as well.

attribute_definitions.name: Alternative text (required)
attribute_definitions.description: Required before Apply is enabled. Describe the campaign scene without repeating the product list.

attribute_definitions.name: Products and interactive hotspots
attribute_definitions.description: Open the visual editor to choose free selection or Product Set mode, select products, and place desktop and mobile hotspots.

attribute_definitions.name: Show editorial panel
attribute_definitions.description: Displays an integrated title, description, and action panel below the image.

attribute_definitions.name: Show view-all button
attribute_definitions.description: Displays the action that opens the product list. Requires the editorial panel.

attribute_definitions.name: Reveal hotspots on interaction
attribute_definitions.description: Keeps the campaign image clean. Hover or keyboard focus reveals the hotspots on desktop; the Shop the Look indicator reveals them on touch devices.

attribute_definitions.name: Show product preview on focus
attribute_definitions.description: On desktop, shows current name, price, and availability on hover or keyboard focus.

attribute_definitions.name: Shop-set label
attribute_definitions.description: Opens the standard Quick Add for the Product Set.
